name: Stephen A. Crystal
title: Founder & CEO
credentialLine: 30+ years in gaming · $3B+ in M&A · 130+ industry partners
bio: Stephen A. Crystal is the founder and CEO of SCCG Management, a leading global advisory firm in the gambling industry. Over three decades, he has led more than $3 billion in project finance, M&A, and gaming technology advancements - from tribal and riverboat gaming to Las Vegas casino ownership. He has secured major sports betting deals with teams including the Bengals and Golden Knights, and has supported over 130 client-partners across more than 100 countries.
